open_blockers.claim: The twist check and its 0.05 mm criterion are not justified, and on the real face geometry the declared case fails the designer's own relaxed criterion. (a) The "abuse case" load is 3 N, which equals force_band_max_n, the top of the normal press band. Its 4 mm offset lies inside the face rather than at its edge: the window spans z 10-18 and the leaf centreline is at z 12.5, so the top edge is 5.5 mm off the leaf axis. A normal-magnitude press on the upper part of the face is therefore labelled abuse. (b) With the 0.15 mm criterion used for normal presses, both twist checks fail (0.1404 and 0.0993 mm). The change to 0.05 mm has no stated basis, such as a tolerance stack or the consequence of contact. It is also smaller than the print accuracy the contract itself lists as unqualified for the 0.4 mm gaps. This is a threshold lowered until the check passes, which project rules forbid. (c) A 3 N press at the real top edge gives 16.5 N·mm, i.e. 1.76 deg by the recipe's own beam_twist_deg (twist scales linearly with torque). At that angle my read-only probe of the exported STEPs measured 0.043 mm to the shell with the button at rest pose, which is below 0.05 mm, and 0.058-0.071 mm when combined with press rotation. The opposite sign (-1.76 deg) reaches 0.000 mm. (d) The plan says "normal presses keep 0.15 mm", but no check combines press rotation with the twist that any off-axis press produces. The face centroid (z about 14) is itself 1.5 mm off the leaf axis. My probe found 0.29-0.31 mm for a 3 N centroid press combined with full press, so the statement is plausible, but it is unverified in the record.
evidence: recipe design_parameters: edge_press_force_n 3.0, edge_press_offset_mm 4.0, force_band_max_n 3.0, window_z_min/max 10/18, leaf_z_min/max 6.5/18.5 (leaf axis z 12.5), twist_min_gap_mm 0.05
measurements.json twist-positive-clear end distance 0.1404 mm; twist-negative-clear 0.0993 mm, continuous_distance_lower_bound 0.0179 mm, continuous_swept_motion not_proven, yet verdict pass
verification_plan: "Twist (abuse case, ASSUMED 3 N at the face edge) ... stays at least 0.05 mm (normal presses keep 0.15 mm)"

Read-only CadQuery probe on button+actuator_insert vs shell STEP: twist +1.759 deg -> 0.0434 mm; -1.759 deg -> 0.0 mm; press -1.07/-2.14 deg + twist +1.759 -> 0.0576/0.0708 mm; twist +/-1.279 reproduces 0.1404/0.0993 mm
Task note: criterion first drafted at 0.15 mm and set to 0.05 mm by the designer before freezing; AGENTS.md forbids lowering thresholds to pass
unverified_requirements: "print accuracy of the 0.4 mm gaps ... not qualified"
open_blockers.proposed_change: Do not lower the criterion. Either fix the geometry, e.g. put the leaf axis at the face centroid height and/or widen or thicken the leaf so a 3 N press at the real face edge (5.5 mm, or the true worst-case arm) keeps at least 0.15 mm in combined press plus twist poses. Or keep 0.15 mm and report the twist case as a FAIL or open risk to the owner. Derive edge_press_offset_mm from the face geometry instead of a free constant. Drop the "abuse" label unless the load exceeds the normal force band. If a smaller abuse gap is ever wanted, state its basis (load above the normal band, tolerance stack, consequence of contact) in the contract.
open_blockers.required_test: Rebuild and run twist checks at the torque from 3 N at the measured top-edge and bottom-edge arms, both alone and combined with press rotation at 0, mid and deepest angles (with the pivot-play offsets), with at least 0.15 mm required. Add a recorded combined press-plus-twist check for a centroid press. Use enough samples that continuous_swept_motion is not "not_proven".

open_blockers.claim: The mount does not locate the carrier relative to the window. Both pins sit on one vertical line (x=-33.5, z=9 and 14.5, 5.5 mm apart) in block holes with 0.1 mm radial clearance (r 1.1 vs pin r 1.0). Nothing else fixes x, z or rotation about the press axis (y): the block is only clamped between the pin heads and the post end faces, and the tab-on-lug contact acts in y only. The declared clearance allows about +/-2.08 deg of rotation about y (asin(0.1/2.75)). At the far end of the face, about 50 mm from the pins, that is about +/-1.8 mm, against a 0.4 mm running gap. Every passed clearance, press and twist check assumes the nominal carrier pose, so they do not describe the assembly that this mount allows.
evidence: recipe ops block_hole_1/2: radius 1.1 at x=-33.5, z=9.0/14.5; pin_1/2_shank radius 1.0; design_parameters pin_clearance_mm 0.1
design_basis assembly: "carrier in from the cavity side until the tab meets the lug, then the two pins pressed through the block into the posts". No locating feature or fit is named.

Reviewer probe (read-only, CadQuery 2.8 on the exported model.step files of button, actuator_insert, shell, rest_stop; BRepExtrema distance and boolean intersection volume): button+insert rotated about a y axis through (-33.5, 18.25, 11.75): +/-0.25 deg leaves 0.193/0.190 mm to the shell; +/-0.5 deg gives 0.0 mm (contact); +/-2.084 deg (the full play) overlaps the shell by 25.7 / 22.1 mm3.

Reviewer probe (read-only, CadQuery 2.8 on the exported model.step files of button, actuator_insert, shell, rest_stop; BRepExtrema distance and boolean intersection volume): a +/-0.1 mm translation in x or z alone leaves 0.30 mm, so translation is acceptable. The rotation about y is the defect.
measurements.json rest-button-shell 0.400 mm and press/twist rotation checks are evaluated only at the nominal carrier pose (axis_play_mm models hinge play in x-y, not carrier yaw).
open_blockers.proposed_change: Give the carrier a datum. Make one pin a locating fit in the block (line-to-line or light press) and the other a slot along the pin line, and space the pins along x (the leaf direction) rather than z. Or add a printed locating boss or key between the block and a post. Then state the remaining yaw and translation play as a parameter.
open_blockers.required_test: Add a rotation check that rotates the whole carrier (button, leaf, block and insert) about the y axis through the pin pattern by the mount play angle derived from the declared clearances, in both directions, plus the +/-x/z translation play, against shell and rest_stop with min 0.15 mm (or the chosen running-gap criterion). Re-run the press-to-deepest checks at those worst-case carrier poses.
